verdict.rationale: Stripe documents several API- and CLI-driven paths that run without a UI: machine payments that work 'without a checkout UI', the `mppx validate` CLI that checks an implementation end-to-end, Stripe CLI provisioning of anonymous sandboxes with working keys for coding agents, and the npm-published Link CLI. Full unattended automation is limited because Link CLI spends need customer approval for each request and some MCP write actions need human confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples, fully unattended purchase flows without per-request human approval, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless or CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
